def process(precip_clean, water_exceedance) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import numpy as np
    
    months = [6, 7, 8]
    month_names = {6: 'Jun', 7: 'Jul', 8: 'Aug'}
    years = [2007, 2008, 2009]
    
    # Stations for each beach type
    freshwater_stations = ['Boston', 'Chatham', 'Amherst', 'Ashburnham']
    marine_stations = ['Boston', 'Chatham']
    
    # Impute missing values with median of the month across non-missing years
    month_cols = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
    precip_imputed = precip_clean.copy()
    for station in precip_imputed['station'].unique():
        mask = precip_imputed['station'] == station
        for col in month_cols:
            col_vals = precip_imputed.loc[mask, col]
            median_val = col_vals.median()  # median ignores NaN
            precip_imputed.loc[mask, col] = col_vals.fillna(median_val)
    
    # For each beach type, compute average monthly rainfall across relevant stations
    # Filter to years 2007-2009
    precip_filtered = precip_imputed[precip_imputed['Year'].isin(years)]
    
    results = []
    for beach_type, stations in [('Freshwater', freshwater_stations), ('Marine', marine_stations)]:
        station_data = precip_filtered[precip_filtered['station'].isin(stations)]
        
        # Average rainfall across stations for each year-month combo
        rain_rows = []
        for year in years:
            for month_num in months:
                month_col = month_names[month_num]
                yr_data = station_data[station_data['Year'] == year]
                avg_rain = yr_data[month_col].mean()
                rain_rows.append({'year': year, 'month': month_num, 'avg_rainfall': avg_rain})
        
        rain_df = pd.DataFrame(rain_rows)
        
        # Get exceedance data for this beach type
        wt_label = 'Fresh' if beach_type == 'Freshwater' else 'Marine'
        exc_df = water_exceedance[water_exceedance['Beach Type Description'] == wt_label][['year', 'month', 'exceedance_rate']]
        
        # Merge rainfall with exceedance
        merged = rain_df.merge(exc_df, on=['year', 'month'])
        
        # Compute Pearson correlation
        corr = merged['avg_rainfall'].corr(merged['exceedance_rate'])
        results.append({
            'Beach Type': beach_type,
            'Correlation': corr,
            'N': len(merged)
        })
        # Print details for inspection
        print(f"\n{beach_type} merged data:")
        print(merged.to_string())
        print(f"Correlation: {corr:.4f}")
    
    return pd.DataFrame(results)

def process(precip_clean, water_exceedance):
    import numpy as np
    from scipy.stats import pearsonr

    months = [6, 7, 8]
    years = [2007, 2008, 2009]
    month_names = {6: 'Jun', 7: 'Jul', 8: 'Aug'}

    # Step 1: Impute missing values per station per month using median of non-missing years
    precip_imputed = precip_clean.copy()
    for station in precip_imputed['station'].unique():
        mask = precip_imputed['station'] == station
        for m_name in ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']:
            col_vals = precip_imputed.loc[mask, m_name]
            median_val = col_vals.dropna().median()
            precip_imputed.loc[mask & precip_imputed[m_name].isna(), m_name] = median_val

    # Step 2: For each beach type, compute average monthly rainfall across relevant stations
    freshwater_stations = ['Boston', 'Chatham', 'Amherst', 'Ashburnham']
    marine_stations = ['Boston', 'Chatham']

    results = []
    for beach_type, stations in [('Freshwater', freshwater_stations), ('Marine', marine_stations)]:
        rain_vals = []
        exc_vals = []
        for year in years:
            for month in months:
                m_name = month_names[month]
                # Average rainfall across stations for this year/month
                station_mask = (precip_imputed['station'].isin(stations)) & (precip_imputed['Year'] == year)
                avg_rain = precip_imputed.loc[station_mask, m_name].mean()
                rain_vals.append(avg_rain)

                # Exceedance rate for this beach type/year/month
                exc_mask = (
                    (water_exceedance['Beach Type Description'] == ('Fresh' if beach_type == 'Freshwater' else 'Marine')) &
                    (water_exceedance['year'] == year) &
                    (water_exceedance['month'] == month)
                )
                exc_rate = water_exceedance.loc[exc_mask, 'exceedance_rate'].values[0]
                exc_vals.append(exc_rate)

        corr, pval = pearsonr(rain_vals, exc_vals)
        results.append({
            'Beach Type': beach_type,
            'Correlation': corr,
            'p_value': pval,
            'N': len(rain_vals),
            'rain_vals': str([round(v, 4) for v in rain_vals]),
            'exc_vals': str([round(v, 4) for v in exc_vals])
        })

    return pd.DataFrame(results)

def process(precip_clean, water_exceedance):
    from scipy import stats
    import numpy as np

    months = ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']
    month_map = {'Jun': 6, 'Jul': 7, 'Aug': 8}
    years = [2007, 2008, 2009]

    # Impute missing values per station per month using median of non-missing years
    imputed_rows = []
    for station, grp in precip_clean.groupby('station'):
        grp = grp.copy()
        for m in months:
            non_missing = grp[m].dropna()
            median_val = non_missing.median()
            grp[m] = grp[m].fillna(median_val)
        imputed_rows.append(grp)
    
    import pandas as pd
    precip_imputed = pd.concat(imputed_rows, ignore_index=True)

    # Define station groups
    freshwater_stations = ['Boston', 'Chatham', 'Amherst', 'Ashburnham']
    marine_stations = ['Boston', 'Chatham']

    # Build rainfall lookup: (station, year, month_name) -> value
    results = []
    for beach_type, stations, label in [
        ('Fresh', freshwater_stations, 'Freshwater'),
        ('Marine', marine_stations, 'Marine')
    ]:
        rain_vals = []
        exc_vals = []
        for yr in years:
            for m_name, m_num in month_map.items():
                # Average rainfall across stations for this year/month
                subset = precip_imputed[
                    (precip_imputed['station'].isin(stations)) &
                    (precip_imputed['Year'] == yr)
                ]
                rain = subset[m_name].mean()
                # Exceedance rate
                exc_row = water_exceedance[
                    (water_exceedance['Beach Type Description'] == beach_type) &
                    (water_exceedance['year'] == yr) &
                    (water_exceedance['month'] == m_num)
                ]
                if len(exc_row) == 0:
                    continue
                exc = exc_row['exceedance_rate'].values[0]
                rain_vals.append(rain)
                exc_vals.append(exc)

        r, p = stats.pearsonr(rain_vals, exc_vals)
        results.append({
            'Beach Type': label,
            'Correlation': r,
            'p_value': p,
            'N': len(rain_vals),
            'rain_vals': rain_vals,
            'exc_vals': exc_vals
        })

    return pd.DataFrame(results)

    from scipy.stats import pearsonr
    import numpy as np

    months = [6, 7, 8]
    month_map = {6: 'Jun', 7: 'Jul', 8: 'Aug'}

    # Step 1: Impute missing values per station per month using median of non-missing years
    df = precip_clean.copy()
    for station in df['station'].unique():

        for m_name in ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']:
            col_vals = df.loc[mask, m_name]
            median_val = col_vals.median()  # NaN-safe
            df.loc[mask & df[m_name].isna(), m_name] = median_val

    # Step 2: Filter to 2007-2009
    df_years = df[df['Year'].isin([2007, 2008, 2009])]

    # Step 3: Compute average rainfall per (year, month) for each beach type
    freshwater_stations = ['Boston', 'Chatham', 'Amherst', 'Ashburnham']
    marine_stations = ['Boston', 'Chatham']

    records = []
    for btype, stations in [('Freshwater', freshwater_stations), ('Marine', marine_stations)]:
        sub = df_years[df_years['station'].isin(stations)]
        for _, row in sub.iterrows():
            year = int(row['Year'])
            for m in months:
                m_name = month_map[m]
                records.append({'beach_type': btype, 'year': year, 'month': m, 'rainfall': row[m_name]})

    import pandas as pd
    rain_df = pd.DataFrame(records)
    # Average across stations for each (beach_type, year, month)

    merged = rain_avg.merge(exc_sub, on=['beach_type', 'year', 'month'], how='inner')

    # Step 5: Compute Pearson correlation per beach type
    results = []
    for btype, grp in merged.groupby('beach_type'):
        grp_sorted = grp.sort_values(['year', 'month'])
        r, p = pearsonr(grp_sorted['avg_rainfall'], grp_sorted['exceedance_rate'])
        results.append({
